implementation:
let rec go (rest acc : List Nat) : List Nat :=
  match rest with
  | [] => acc
  | x :: tail => go tail (x :: acc)
go xs []
proof:
by
  unfold Spec
  have invariant : ∀ rest acc : List Nat,
      candidate.go rest acc = rest.reverse ++ acc := by
    intro rest
    induction rest with
    | nil => intro acc; rfl
    | cons x rest ih =>
      intro acc
      simpa [candidate.go, List.reverse_cons, List.append_assoc] using ih (x :: acc)
  intro xs
  simpa [candidate] using invariant xs []
